sentences.text:
By way of present writ-application filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India the writ-applicant herein has prayed for the following reliefs :-
"(A) Direct the Respondent -The Chief Officer - Sahera Nagar Palika to process the application filed by the Petitioner at Annexure A to this Petition and Grant a Legal and Valid NOC and Permission for Running Slaughter expeditiously without booking any delay as Petitioner is identical situated as Order as CAV order dated 11.4.2023 passed in CA NO 10 OF 2023 IN WRIT PETITION (PIL) No. 133 of 2021 by this Honorable Court Annexure-B and (B) Direct the Respondent -The Chief Officer - Nadirbhai Hakimbhai Shekh vs The Chief Officer, Sahera Nagar Palika on 23 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/156587742/
1

Sahera Nagar NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/20945/2023 ORDER DATED:
23/01/2024 undefined

Palika to process the application filed by the Petitioner at Annexure A to this Petition and to give opportunity of hearing to Grant a Legal and Valid NOC and Permission for Running Slaughter and (B) grant any other relief or pass any other order, which the Honourable Court may consider just and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case and in the interest of justice.

And for this act of kindness and justice, the petitioner as in duty bound shall for ever pray."
2.
Heard Mr. Nabil O. Bloch, the learned advocate appearing for the writ-applicant and Mr. Chirag B. Patel, the learned advocate appearing for the respondent.

3. It is the case of the writ-applicant that by way of present writ-application the writ-applicant herein seeks direction to provide legal and valid NOC and permission for running slaughter house under the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 for licensing and registration of food business.

4. Being aggrieved and dissatisfied with the respondent - NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/20945/2023 ORDER DATED: 23/01/2024 undefined Godhra Nagarpalia wherein such license has not been issued the writ-applicant herein has approached this Court for the prayers as referred above.

5. Mr. Bloch, the learned advocate appearing for the writ- applicant on instructions states that the writ-applicant would prefer an application in the prescribed format with the respondent authority and that the same be decided by the respondent authority in terms of the order passed by the Hon'ble Division Bench in the Civil Application No.10 of 2023 in Writ Petition (PIL) No.133 of 2021 dated 11.4.2023 in paragraphs 6.3 and 6.4.
6.

Mr. Patel, the learned advocate appearing for the respondent authority submitted that the respondent authority would consider if such an application is filed in line with the order dated 11.4.2023 passed in the Civil Application No.10 of 2023 in Writ Petition (PIL) No.133 of 2021.
NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/20945/2023 ORDER DATED: 23/01/2024 undefined 7.

Considering the aforesaid and statement made by Mr. Bloch, the learned advocate appearing for the writ-applicant, if the writ-applicant were to approach the respondent authority by preferring an application in the prescribed format seeking permission to run a slaughter house, the same be considered by the respondent authority in accordance with law and in line with the ratio laid down in order dated 11.4.2023 passed in the Civil Application No.10 of 2023 in Writ Petition (PIL) No.133 of 2021.
8.
The present writ-application stands disposed of accordingly.
